title: Unify host resource probes with timestamps, provenance, and unknown-not-zero semantics
goal: The GPU probe reports 0 VRAM when the device is absent; CPU/RAM observations carry no timestamp or provenance; ResourceInventory is not integrated into production host profiling. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
